releaseNotes: Searchable database picker (the native select could not be filtered, and this connection reports 62 schemas) with full keyboard control. Relationship cardinality is now drawn as a single 1:N badge on the edge at the curve midpoint. Also fixes: HAVING no longer accepts a free-form expression, foreign-key edges are always labelled 1:N instead of guessing at junction tables, and the test mock is no longer reachable from the shipped bundle.
